Maria B: morning — quick sync: onboarding + shadowing plan for new on-call hires next week. trying to close coverage gaps before the holiday stretch

Ajay K: thanks. which gaps are we looking at? i can cover primary for fri-sun if needed

Maria B: thanks Ajay. main gap is sat 8am-4pm PT (no primary signed up). also need a buddy for nina's shadow session on thursday pm

Devon: i can take sat 8-12pt primary. Ajay, if you can do 12-4 that'd fill it. otherwise i'll extend my shift

Nina S: hi! i'm the new hire — super excited. @Maria B said i'd shadow a few incidents and walk through the runbook. curious what prep i should do

Maria B: awesome, welcome Nina. prep: read the oncall runbook (link below), install pager tools, and watch the incident-response quick video. we'll do a pairing window thursday 2pm PT where we'll walk a mock page and handoff.

Maria B: runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-core (read section: escalation flows, customer-impact classification, and rollback playbooks)

Sam O: FYI the incident bot replayed an older page this morning for test — pager-bot posted 2156783000. nothing real. oncall-bot will post any real paging alerts

oncall-bot: [automated] New page received: high error-rate / v1-generation. Incident created: INC-2026-0421. Assigned to: Maria B (primary)

Maria B: linking that because it's a good rehearsal for the mock. Nina, during the pairing i'll show you how i triage a high-error-rate page: quick checks, rx logs, and customer impact assessment

Nina S: helpful — can you paste the triage checklist now? i want to skim ahead

Maria B: sure, here's a compact checklist i use:
```
1) Confirm alert: check metrics and recent deploys
2) Identify scope: % of requests failing, affected endpoints, regions
3) Customer impact: partial degradation vs full outage (notify success/sales)
4) Mitigation: switch traffic to fallback model / scale pool / roll back config
5) Communicate: update #incidents and pager channel every 15m
6) Escalate if >30m and no mitigation 
```

Ajay K: tiny note: when switching to fallback model, add a tag in console so ops can correlate billing/latency effects (helps postmortem)

Devon: also remember to check the KV cache health — we've seen degraded caches manifest as tokenization errors recently

Maria B: good call. nina, you'll get a temporary access token for the console and a shadow PagerDuty profile tonight. we'll use the staging cluster for the mock incident

Nina S: got it. what about handoffs? i read that primary -> secondary handoffs can be messy when overlapping incidents happen

Sam O: best practice we follow:
- do a 1-2 minute sync in thread before the handoff (current status, actions, and blockers)
- transfer primary ownership in PagerDuty and confirm in chat
- if major incident, do a quick voice check (teams/hangout)

Maria B: yep. here's a tiny handoff template you can paste into the chat during a real handoff:
```
Handoff: primary -> secondary
Status: mitigation in progress (e.g., scaled pool to 6 nodes)
Customer impact: ~5% requests failing, US-east only
Actions taken: rolled back config 2026-04-21-14, started fallback model v1.2
Next steps: watch logs for 15m, if errors persist, failover region
Owner: Maria B -> Ajay K (accepted)
```

Ajay K: i'll accept primary for sat 12-4pt as discussed. will add to calendar and update rota

Maria B: thanks. Sam, can you add nina to the oncall rota for shadow session and give her the temporary PagerDuty role tonight?

Sam O: yes — assigning PD shadow profile now. done. nina should get email in ~5m.

pager-bot: [automated] PagerDuty: temporary role assigned to Nina S for oncall-shadow (expires 2026-04-30)

Nina S: i got the invite, thank you! quick question — when we do mock pages, should i respond as if i'm primary or watch only?

Maria B: watch-only for the first mock, then you'll do the next one as acting primary while i supervise. aim to practice both triage and communication

Devon: small logistics note: if anyone is scheduled for a follow-up handoff during a holiday window, mark the incident as "handoff+backup" so routing doesn't auto-escalate to a different pool

Ajay K: noted. also, can we add a short blurb to the runbook about shadow expiration tokens? new folks keep keeping tokens forever and it's a security pain

Maria B: agreed. i'll file a tiny PR to runbook after the pairing. Nina — optional pre-reading: search for `incident-pager-ops` in docs, and try the `oncall-setup` script in staging: `./oncall-setup.sh --shadow`

Nina S: will do. thanks everyone for the warm welcome! excited for thursday 2pm 

Maria B: last thing — if anyone notices a real page while we're in mock, shout in this thread and we'll pause the exercise. otherwise, see you at the pairing. :wave:
